summary: Mitsutoshi Moriguchi is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Indology. He completed doctoral studies at Taisho University, where he also served as a lecturer (attested 1989–1995).
Mitsuyo Demoto is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Indology who studied at Kyoto University. She held an attested post at the University of Marburg in 2024.

Mitsuyoshi Saegusa (1923–2010) was a scholar of Buddhist studies, Indology, and philosophy. He earned his Ph.D. at the University of Munich under Helmut Hoffmann and held professorships at Nihon University (~1970–1972) and the University of Tsukuba (1975–1987).

Mitsuyuki Ishida (1911–1991) specialized in Buddhist studies, graduating from Ryukoku University (~1931–1934). He served as a professor at Ryukoku University (~1950–1981) and Shitennoji University (attested 1976).

Mittal Trivedi works in Indology and linguistics. After earning an Acharya degree at Maharaja Sayajirao University of Baroda (2017–2019), Trivedi held a dottorandi post at the University of Cagliari from 2020 to 2024.
Miyako Notake is a scholar of Indology, Buddhist studies, and philosophy who served as a part-time lecturer at Waseda University (attested in 2015 and 2026).
Miyoko Nakano (born 1933) is a sinologist who studied at Hokkaido University from ~1952 to 1956 and later held a post there from ~1968 to 1996.

Mizuho Okita (born 1977) works in Indology and religious studies. She studied at Tokai University and Gakushuin University under Katsuhiko Kamimura and doctoral supervisor Atsuhiko Yoshida, later serving as a part-time lecturer at Meisei University (attested 2008).
Mizumaro Ishida (1917–2003) was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Japanology who served as a professor at Tokai University (attested 1976 and 1987).
Mohammad Ashraf Dar works in history, archaeology, and Indology. He earned a Master of Philosophy at Vikram University, where he also served as a research scholar (attested 2014).

Mohammad Habib (1895–1971) was a scholar of history, archaeology, and Indology who studied at the University of Allahabad, Aligarh Muslim University (~1911–1916), and New College (~1916–1920). He also taught Saiyid Athar Abbas Rizvi.

Mohan G. Dhadphale is an Indology and Buddhist studies scholar who taught Senmyo Naniwa, Chikafumi Watanabe, and Andy Rotman. He held a professorship at Tilak Maharashtra Vidyapeeth (attested 2000) and edited Annals at the Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute (attested 2003).

Mokurai Shimaji (1838–1911) was a scholar of Buddhist and religious studies who studied under Chō Sanshū. He served as Geschäftsführer at Nishi Hongan-ji (1870) and as head priest at Gankyo-ji (1892–1905).

Mona Schrempf is a scholar of Tibetology and religious studies who earned a doctorate at Free University of Berlin in 2001. In 2006, she was attested as a fellow at Humboldt University and teacher at Heidelberg University.

Monia Chies is a scholar of Tibetology and religious studies. She earned a master's degree from Ca' Foscari University of Venice in 2011 and was a PhD candidate at Humboldt University of Berlin in 2013.

Monica Esposito (1962–2011) was a scholar of sinology and religious studies who earned her PhD from the University of Paris/Paris Diderot. She held postdoctoral posts at several universities and became an associate professor at Kyoto University in 2003.

Monica L. Smith is a scholar of history, archaeology, and Indology who studied at the University of Michigan (~1992–1997). She held a post at the University of Pittsburgh (2000–2002) before joining the University of California, Los Angeles in 2002.

Monier Monier-Williams (1819–1899) was an Indologist and linguist who studied at Oxford under Horace Hayman Wilson. He taught at East India Company College (1844–1858) and served as Boden Professor of Sanskrit at Oxford from 1860 to 1887.

Monika Boehm-Tettelbach (born 1941) is a scholar of Indology and linguistics who earned her doctorate under Heinz-Jürgen Pinnow. She held professorships at Bonn, Cologne, Bamberg (~1989–1994), and Heidelberg University (1990–2006).
Monika Nowakowska is a scholar of Indology and philosophy who held posts in the Chair of South Asian Studies at the University of Warsaw (attested in 2010 and 2026).
